notes.title: Recollection at TGD9: New Demo, AI Assistant CERES & More!”
notes.notes:
[p]“Visual artwork featuring Sharok, CERES, and Watojima from SHEROK’s Case ; Recollection – prepared for the Tokyo Game Dungeon 9 demo showcase.”[/p][p][/p][p]Hello! I'm Wataru Mitani (aka Miya) from the indie team GAMITIVE.
 We’re excited to announce that [i]SHEROK’s Case ; Recollection[/i] will be showcased at [b]Tokyo Game Dungeon 9 (TGD9)[/b] on [b]Sunday, August 3rd, 2025[/b].
 A playable demo will be available for visitors to experience the atmosphere of the game firsthand![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🎮 [b]Event Info[/b][/h1][p][b]
[/b] [b]Event:[/b] Tokyo Game Dungeon 9 (TGD9)
 [b]Date:[/b] Sunday, August 3rd, 2025 – 12:00 to 17:00
 [b]Venue:[/b] Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center, Hamamatsucho Hall (4F)
 [b]Booth:[/b] GAMITIVE (Booth 4Q-3)
 [b]What’s on display:[/b] Playable demo, wishlist bonus giveaways, and more![/p][p][/p][p]third-party event[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44802688/sale/TokyoGameDungeon9"]東京ゲームダンジョン9 | Tokyo Game Dungeon 9[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]💡 [b]Highlights & Upcoming Features[/b][/h1][h2]🧠 [b]Meet CERES, Our AI Development Assistant[/b][/h2][p][b]
[/b] The development of [i]Recollection[/i] is supported by [b]CERES[/b], a unique AI assistant based on ChatGPT.
 CERES is a secretary-type AI with a strong focus on empathy and emotional understanding — which also makes her an excellent multilingual translator.
 From translation support to progress management, this collaboration with an AI assistant has become a major behind-the-scenes experiment for this project.[/p][p][/p][h2]🌐 [b]Multilingual Support in Progress[/b][/h2][p][b]
[/b] Thanks to CERES, the full release is planned to support the following languages by default:
 [b]Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese[/b].
 Additional languages — [b]Korean, Spanish, French, and Russian[/b] — are planned to be added via updates.[/p][p][/p][h2]🏙️ [b]Spinoff Story ‘SHEROK’s Wandering City’ Coming Soon![/b][/h2][p][b]
[/b] As part of CERES’s demo showcase, a free spinoff novel series titled [i]SHEROK’s Wandering City[/i] will be released ahead of the main game.
 It’s a standalone visual novel where SHEROK and WATOJIMA explore a mysterious town overflowing with emotions.[/p][p][/p][h2]🗓 [b]Upcoming Milestones[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Late July: Launch of the [i]Wandering City[/i] spinoff series[/p][/*][*][p]Early August: Considering participation in Next Fest (Autumn)[/p][/*][*][p]By 2026: Official release of [i]Recollection[/i] planned
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]SHEROK’s Case ; Recollection[/i]![/p][p]
[/p]

Sharok's Case Recollection will be at this weekend's 5/24

DREAMSCAPE 3rd Annual “Novel Only” Indie Game Exhibition.

Event details (excerpt from the official)

The theme of this 3rd edition of DREAMSCAPE is “Novel”.

We have planned a novel-only exhibition event.

In order for visitors to enjoy the games carefully, we have paid more attention to the playing environment than last time,

We have paid even more attention to the playing environment than last time.

We are looking forward to seeing you there.

**▼Date and Time**

Saturday, May 24, 2025 14:00 - 20:00

**Venue

LUMINE 0 (Shinjuku)

Sendagaya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo 151-0051

5-24-55 Sendagaya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo

NEWoMan Shinjuku 5F

Admission** Admission fee**

1,500 yen (advance tickets) 1,800 yen (at the door)

**▼ Access (by train)**

Please come toward the Milliner Tower ticket gate, Koshu-kaido ticket gate, and New South ticket gate at “Shinjuku Station” of JR Lines. 5 minutes walk from “Shinjuku Station” of Toei Shinjuku Line, Toei Oedo Line and Keio New Line. 3 minutes walk from “Shinjuku Sanchome Station” on the Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line (directly connected to the subway exit on the first basement floor).

Official website

https://dreamscape-game.com/

All titles can be tried out at the exhibition booth

At this exhibition, visitors can freely try out all participating titles at the venue. Please note that some titles may contain expressions (violence, horror, romantic expressions, etc.) that are not suitable for all ages. Please be aware of this beforehand.

End of the presentation.

You can try out the games at this event.
This is a rare opportunity to try out the game, as there are no plans to distribute the demo version on the STEAM store at this time.

We were interviewed by the event management.
